steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates said Thomson Reuters announced its AI tool Co-Counsel had over one million users and used Anthropic and other AI agents, highlighting rapid uptake of a new product in its legal software suite.

views.text: In March 2026, Equity Mates noted Thomson Reuters’ share price jumped 10% on the day of the Co-Counsel announcement, 10% the next day, and rose in five of the next six days, indicating a strong market reaction to the news.
